title: Specialty (re)insurance technology for brokers and insurers | Artificial
description: Artificial is the power between brokers and insurers in the specialty market. Underwriting technology and placement tools to move risk faster, with less in the way.
headings: Insurance infrastructure built for the AI era
AI decisions you can stand behind
text: Specialty (re)insurance technology for brokers and insurers | Artificial Brokers Underwriters Resources Articles Podcasts Company About Careers Contact us Insurance infrastructure built for the AI era Faster connectivity between brokers and underwriters. Find out more We build the infrastructure that lets brokers and insurers trade risk the way the market should move: fast, connected, and built to last. For underwriters Underwriting the risk, or stuck re-keying it? Moving data between spreadsheets traps underwriters in admin mode. The Artificial Risk Terminal captures the right data once, to keep decisions flowing. Explore underwriters For brokers Placing the risk, or stuck preparing it? Chasing documents and reformatting submissions keeps brokers away from the market. Artificial structures the data at source, so the day is spent on placement, not preparation. Explore brokers Powering the market Artificial Risk Terminal One platform, every step of the insurance cycle. Contact us Algorithmic underwriting Deploy complex underwriting appetites in real time, augmented with human oversight. Underwriting workbench Spend your time assessing risk and building your book, not on paperwork. Aggregation & reporting Aggregate, monitor and report on risk in real time, enabling more effective capital deployment. Open market Complex open market risks, underwritten faster with proprietary tech. Portfolio underwriting Take a portfolio approach to writing a whole portfolio of complex risks. Capital deployment Optimise how capital is deployed to risk, and do it quickly and safely. Delegated authority Delegate authority, but keep the control. Consortia Digitising fixed term lead and follow workflow to ensure efficient attachment of capital through real-time reporting. Core broking engine Enable brokers to spend all of their time with customers, and broking, rather than on admin. Facilities Manage and run all types of facilities on a single platform, without changing how brokers need to work. Trackers Run a tracker across your entire business, structuring necessary data with minimal effort. Live utilisation, aggregates and signing metrics, updated as business binds. Distribution and capital Seamless matching of capital to risk. No portals, no re-keying. Proven results $80bn Premium processed across the Artificial Risk Platform Across specialty and commercial lines, the market trades here. Underwriters, brokers and coverholders writing and placing risk on one platform. 80% Reduction in admin costs for global broker Artificial takes the re-keying and document handling off the desk, so brokers can spend the day on what matters. 7 seconds Time to complete a transaction By automating a complex placement workflow, Artificial reduced transaction times from hours to just seven seconds. AI decisions you can stand behind Not a black box. Every AI decision follows your rules, so you can trace, explain and defend any outcome to any stakeholder. Your rules govern the system, not the other way round.
